skimmer.name: the royal skimmer
skimmer.description: A long flat-bottomed craft of pale wood and beaten brass that rides the sand as a boat rides water, on a hiss of loosened grains.
skimmer.board_text: You climb aboard the royal skimmer. Its deck shivers under your feet, eager.
skimmer.disembark_text: You step down from the skimmer onto firm ground.
skimmer.note: Lent by King Osric once Lucan is with the party. Crosses the sand sea; cannot follow the party into the Sandmaw's tunnels.
